name: new_v1_seven_axis_validation_only_full_bank_decision_v1
decision_rule: Retain F0v2 unless one independently defined addition has nondecreasing pooled validation macro-F1 and nonincreasing validation log loss on every available axis, with strict improvement on at least one axis. For synthetic quality use prespecified six-coordinate fault-family mean macro-F1 and mean named-fault log loss; require nondecreasing clean and minimum named-fault macro-F1 as an additional guard. Compare each arm only with the matched F0v2 baseline within the same axis, never raw scores across datasets. Do not consult final metrics for selection.
interpretation: A conservative deployment-default gate, not a claim that every public axis is independent or that conditional specialists have no value. ROAM posture and quality share recordings; GRAB unseen-user and cross-day share recordings. No hardware or own-device acceptance claim.
